title: Houthi Strike on Saudi Airport Kills 2 as U.S. Tells Some Diplomats to Leave
summary_full: The airport is in Dammam, which is near the headquarters of oil giant Saudi Aramco. For weeks, Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthi militia has been attacking the kingdom’s aviation and energy sectors.
